ios.desc:
The fantastically simple and highly effective flashcards app!

BENEFITS FOR THE STUDENTS
• It's simple, no gamification distractions.
• No anxiety from a timer.
• Ability to skip or keep trying a troublesome problem.
• Immediate feedback when a practice set is complete.
• Multiple problem formats; the traditional format: 4 + 6 = __  or the missing addend format:  4 + _ = 10

BENEFITS FOR PARENTS AND TEACHERS
• Highly configurable, all operations are available.
• Frequently missed problems are saved and repeated to increase accuracy.
• Ability to choose a constant number, a great option for multiplication practice!
• Insights into problem accuracy.  Problem sets are saved and the number of attempts for each problem are tracked. 

AVAILABLE METRICS
• Data on how many problems have been practiced grouped by operation
• Data on operations accuracy.  How many problems were solved the first time?
• Data on frequently missed problems.

No subscription plans, all features are available.
Ad free.

quotes.text:
Hi - I wrote a flash card app for my kids.  One of my kids used it a lot from 3rd through 5th grades, and another, started using it in kindergarden and will continue in 1st grade.

The app can be configured to practice all operations, singularly or combined and with any range of numbers.  There is an option to choose a common number so that number shows up in every problem.  There are two different problem types:

8 + 4 = ____

8 + __ = 12.

If a problem is missed 3 times, then it will show up again until that problem is solved successfully 6 times.  There is also a section where you as the parent can review the all the problem history.

Here's a link, feedback is always welcome and appreciated! (support at 4bitshift dot com)  Right now it's iOS only.

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/flash-cards-math-facts/id1149305731
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: Best math app for elementary school kids?
